background.description: Background jobs the agent left running, oldest first: Claude Code's background shells and monitors (while one of its processes holds the output open), Codex's processes started during a turn and alive after it ended. Read-only: nothing is stopped. null for agents whose jobs Trailboss can't tell apart.

kind.description: shell or monitor (Claude Code), process (Codex); more may be added.

label.description: What it runs, on one line, at most 80 characters: the call's description or command (Claude Code), the process's command line (Codex).

since.description: When its process started, in ms since the epoch; null when unknown.

context_pct.description: context_tokens over context_window, as a whole percentage; null when either is unknown, or the tokens exceed the window (a larger-context mode).

context_tokens.description: The prompt of the last response (input plus cache read and written): what the context held; null when unknown.

context_window.description: The context window in tokens the agent runs with: what Codex records; for Claude Code 200k unless its 1M-context mode is on (the last response's requested model ends in [1m], else --model or the settings' model does) or the context already holds more, capped at the price table's max_input_tokens; else the price table's max_input_tokens; null when unknown.

cpu_pct.description: CPU the agent's process tree uses, in percent of one core (over 100 on several cores), to one decimal; null when unknown (no /proc).

effort.description: The reasoning effort the agent runs at, where it records one: the transcript's latest (Codex, pi), else the launch flag (Claude Code --effort, Codex -c model_reasoning_effort, pi --thinking), else Claude Code's settings (effortLevel); null otherwise.

model.description: The model of the session's last response (as the agent names it); null when none is indexed yet, or for Copilot CLI (usage arrives when it ends) unless launched with --model.

needs.description: Why the agent waits on you, in a few words ("Plan to approve", a question's first words, "Run: npm test", "Rate limited", the question a finished turn ended on); null when it doesn't.

needs_kind.description: What kind of request `needs` is, with nothing from the transcript: plan, question, run, edit, read, fetch, search, tool, rate_limit, error, waiting or reply (a turn that ended on a question; more may be added).

pinned.description: The user pinned this terminal or session (`live --pin`).

procs.description: How many processes the agent's tree has, itself included; null when unknown.

quiet_busy.description: Working with no progress for a while, but its processes are busy (a long build or test run): busy, not stuck. `stuck` is the same when they aren't busy.

quiet_min.description: Minutes without transcript progress, when `stuck` or `quiet_busy`; null otherwise.

rss_bytes.description: Resident memory of the agent's process tree, in bytes (memory shared between its processes counted in each); null when unknown.

status_since.description: When the agent entered its current status, in ms since the epoch: as `events` last saw it change, else (at rest) when its last turn ended or its transcript last changed; null when unknown (working, with no earlier look).

tokens_note.description: Why `tokens` isn't the session's total yet, when the agent writes usage only at the end (Copilot CLI: "not until it ends"); null otherwise. A 0 is then shown as null.

turn.description: The turn under way, or the last one finished, counted from the transcript; null without one.

turn_ended_ms.description: When that turn ended, in ms since the epoch; null while it's under way or unknown.
